title: VPN Connection Fails After MFA Approval
content: User reported that VPN authentication succeeded after MFA approval, but the tunnel did not establish. Support verified the user account was active, confirmed the VPN client was one minor version behind, flushed DNS, restarted the client, and tested from a second network. Resolution was to update the VPN client and clear the cached profile. Root cause was a stale VPN profile created before the gateway certificate rotation.
expected_questions: Why does VPN fail after MFA approval?
What should support check when VPN tunnel creation fails?

title: Password Reset Loop After Account Unlock
content: A user could reset the password but was immediately locked out again when signing in to email. Support checked identity logs and found repeated attempts from an old mobile mail profile. Resolution was to remove the stale mobile profile, revoke active sessions, unlock the account, and have the user sign in with the new password. Root cause was cached credentials on an unmanaged mobile client.
expected_questions: Why does a user get locked out after password reset?
What should support do after removing stale credentials?

title: Outbound Email Delayed by DLP Rule
content: Finance users reported delayed outbound email to an approved vendor. Mail trace showed messages held by a data loss prevention rule because attachments matched the finance export pattern. Security reviewed the vendor approval record and released the messages. Permanent fix was to add the vendor domain to the approved finance transfer policy with quarterly review.
expected_questions: Why were finance vendor emails delayed?
Who approves DLP exceptions?

title: Database Access Request Missing Data Owner Approval
content: An analyst requested read access to the curated finance schema. The request was paused because it did not include approval from the finance data owner. Support instructed the requester to attach the approved access form, confirm business purpose, and specify expiration date. Access was granted for 90 days after approval and logged in the access register.
expected_questions: Why was database access paused?
What is needed for curated finance schema access?

title: Docker Build Fails on Private Package Download
content: A Docker image build failed during private package download with a 401 response. The pipeline secret had expired after rotation. Resolution was to update the package registry token in the CI secret store and rerun the build. Prevention is to monitor token expiry dates and use service account credentials where supported.
expected_questions: Why did Docker build fail with 401?
How should package token expiry be prevented?

title: Kubernetes Pod CrashLoopBackOff After Config Change
content: The ingestion worker pod entered CrashLoopBackOff after a config map update. Logs showed the worker could not parse the new batch_size value because it was set to text instead of an integer. Resolution was to correct the config map, restart the deployment, and add validation to the Helm values file.
expected_questions: What caused the ingestion worker CrashLoopBackOff?
How was the Kubernetes config issue fixed?

title: VPN Connectivity Runbook
content: Purpose: restore VPN connectivity for internal users. Prerequisites: identity admin lookup, VPN gateway status dashboard, and user device information. Procedure: confirm the user can complete MFA, verify the account is active, check VPN client version, flush DNS, restart the client, test from another network, and inspect gateway status. Validation: user can authenticate and establish the tunnel. Escalate to Network Operations if authentication succeeds but tunnel creation fails.
expected_questions: How do I troubleshoot VPN connectivity?
When should VPN issues be escalated?

title: Failed Backup Runbook
content: Purpose: restore failed scheduled backups for PostgreSQL services. Prerequisites: database read access, backup job dashboard access, and permission to rerun the job. Procedure: confirm the failed job id, inspect storage capacity, verify database connectivity, rerun the backup with the standard profile, and validate that the backup artifact exists. Rollback is not required for a failed backup rerun. Escalate to Data Platform if storage errors continue after capacity is available.
expected_questions: How do I respond to a failed PostgreSQL backup?
What validation is needed after rerunning backup?

title: Failed Airflow DAG Runbook
content: Purpose: recover failed production Airflow DAGs. Procedure: identify the failed task, inspect task logs, check upstream dataset availability, verify connection credentials, clear only the failed task when inputs are valid, and monitor downstream tasks. Rollback: pause the DAG if repeated retries can duplicate downstream writes. Escalate to Data Engineering if source data is missing or schema changed unexpectedly.
expected_questions: How should failed Airflow DAGs be recovered?
When should an Airflow DAG be paused?

title: CVE Patch Response Runbook
content: Purpose: coordinate response to high severity CVEs affecting managed services. Procedure: confirm affected component and version, map exposed services, check vendor remediation, assign owner team, test the patch in staging, deploy during the approved window, and validate version after deployment. Escalate to Security Operations for internet-facing critical vulnerabilities or active exploitation evidence.
expected_questions: What are the steps for CVE patch response?
When should a vulnerability be escalated to Security Operations?

title: Multi-Factor Authentication Policy
content: All internal users must use multi-factor authentication for VPN, email, cloud consoles, and privileged access systems. Exceptions require approval from Security Operations and must expire within 30 days. Audit evidence includes MFA enrollment status, exception approvals, and access logs. Users who lose a device must contact IT Support for identity verification before MFA reset.
expected_questions: Which systems require MFA?
How long can MFA exceptions last?

title: Backup Retention Policy
content: Production database backups must be retained for 35 days. Monthly compliance snapshots must be retained for 13 months. Backup restoration tests must run at least quarterly and evidence must include job id, restore timestamp, validation query, and owner approval. Exceptions require Data Platform manager approval and must document business risk.
expected_questions: How long are production backups retained?
What evidence is required for restore tests?

title: Cloud Console Access Policy
content: Cloud console access requires manager approval, data owner approval for production data systems, MFA enrollment, and completion of privileged access training. Access must use named accounts and time-bound roles. Shared administrator accounts are prohibited. Reviews occur monthly for privileged roles and quarterly for read-only roles.
expected_questions: What is required for cloud console access?
Are shared administrator accounts allowed?

title: Customer Data Governance Standard
content: Customer data is classified as restricted when it includes direct identifiers, contact details, or account activity. Data owners must define approved use cases, retention, masking requirements, and access review cadence. PII must be masked in analytics sandboxes unless an approved exception exists. Data quality incidents must be logged when completeness or freshness breaches published SLAs.
expected_questions: When is customer data restricted?
When must PII be masked?

title: VPN Gateway Certificate Rotation Incident
content: Summary: after VPN gateway certificate rotation, some clients retained stale profiles and failed tunnel creation after MFA. Impact: 42 remote users could not connect for 55 minutes. Detection: IT support ticket spike and gateway metrics. Root cause: client profile cache did not refresh after certificate replacement. Mitigation: publish profile refresh instructions and push updated client configuration. Prevention: add a pre-rotation test group and post-change client cache validation.
expected_questions: What caused the VPN certificate incident?
How was the VPN incident prevented from recurring?

title: Analytics DAG Late Delivery Incident
content: Summary: the daily analytics DAG missed its 08:00 SLA. Impact: finance dashboard refresh was delayed by 90 minutes. Detection: SLA alert from Airflow. Root cause: upstream raw transactions table arrived late after a source system maintenance window. Mitigation: rerun the transform after source completion. Permanent fix: add source availability sensor and notify finance when upstream delay exceeds 30 minutes.
expected_questions: Why did the analytics DAG miss SLA?
What permanent fix was added for late source data?

title: Data Engineering Laptop Onboarding
content: New data engineers must install Git, Python 3.11 or later, Docker Desktop, database client tools, and the approved IDE. They must request access to the development database, Airflow staging, source control organization, and secrets manager. Validation: clone the onboarding repository, run the local test suite, connect to the development database, and trigger the sample Airflow DAG in staging.

How does a new engineer validate laptop setup?

title: ADR: Use PostgreSQL and pgvector for MVP Retrieval
content: Status: accepted. Context: the MVP needs metadata, query logs, evaluation results, and vector search without operating a separate vector database. Decision: use PostgreSQL with pgvector for documents, chunks, embeddings, feedback, and evaluation tables. Options considered: standalone vector database, Elasticsearch only, and PostgreSQL plus pgvector. Consequence: simpler local deployment and strong metadata filtering, with possible scaling work later.
expected_questions: Why use PostgreSQL and pgvector?
What alternatives were considered for retrieval storage?

title: Access Request FAQ
content: Q: Who approves production database access? A: The data owner and the requester manager must approve production database access. Q: How long should temporary access last? A: Temporary access should include an expiration date and normally lasts 30 to 90 days. Q: What happens if approval is missing? A: IT pauses the request and asks for the missing approval evidence. Q: Where is access recorded? A: Approved access is recorded in the access register.
expected_questions: Who approves production database access?
What happens when approval is missing?

title: Common IT Troubleshooting FAQ
content: Q: What should support check first for VPN failures? A: Confirm MFA completion, account status, client version, DNS resolution, and gateway status. Q: What causes repeated password lockouts? A: Stale credentials on mobile clients, mapped drives, or old mail profiles are common causes. Q: What should be checked for delayed email? A: Mail trace, DLP rules, vendor approval, and attachment classification should be reviewed.

What commonly causes repeated password lockouts?
